tabPPTman: PPT management: the PPT types (HSD code, ring range, name) the PPT tab picks from. Starts on the theater's own Ppt.ini; works without a cartridge.
Label1: The table here is the Planner's own: it starts on the theater's Ppt.ini, and the Planner never writes BMS's Ppt.ini. Personal Save keeps a table of your own.
btnPptDefault: Radar Zone: the theater's PPT types, each ring as far as the app's threat reference gives that system's radar lock range (others keep the theater's range).

dgvPPT: The PPT types: HSD code, ring range in nm and name. Pick a row to change it below.
grpEdit: Change the selected type and press Apply; New adds a type, Del removes one. This changes the table the PPT tab picks from, not the cartridge.
txtName: The type's name, up to 16 characters.
txtRange: The ring's range in nautical miles; 0.1 or less makes the type a marker with no ring.
btnApply: Apply: writes the name, range and code into the selected type. PPTs of that type on the PPT tab follow.
txtCode: The code the HSD shows for it, up to 3 characters, as BMS's Ppt.ini keys it ("10" is an SA-10).
btnDel: Del: removes the selected type from the table.
btnNew: New: adds an empty type at the end of the table, to fill in and Apply.
btnSavePersonal: Save: keeps this table as a .ppi file of your own in the Planner's Files\PPT\Personal folder on the BMS PC.
btnLoadPersonal: Load: reads a .ppi table you saved; it becomes the table the PPT tab picks from.
tabIFF: IFF: which transponder modes are on, and their codes, when the jet loads the cartridge.

numMode3A_D2: Second digit of the Mode 3/A code (the squawk), 0-7.
numMode3A_D1: First digit of the Mode 3/A code (the squawk), 0-7.
numMode2_D4: Fourth digit of the Mode 2 code, 0-7.
numMode2_D3: Third digit of the Mode 2 code, 0-7.
numMode2_D2: Second digit of the Mode 2 code, 0-7.
numMode2_D1: First digit of the Mode 2 code, 0-7.
numMode1_D2: Second digit of the Mode 1 code, 0-7.
numMode1_D1: First digit of the Mode 1 code, 0-7.
chbMode1: Mode 1 on when the jet loads the cartridge, with the two-digit code beside it. Counts in Save to DTC.
chbModeS: Mode S on when the jet loads the cartridge. Counts in Save to DTC.
chbMode2: Mode 2 on when the jet loads the cartridge, with the four-digit code beside it. Counts in Save to DTC.
chbModeC: Mode C (altitude reporting) on when the jet loads the cartridge. Counts in Save to DTC.
chbMode3A: Mode 3/A (the squawk) on when the jet loads the cartridge, with the four-digit code beside it. Counts in Save to DTC.
chbMode4: Mode 4 (the encrypted military mode) on when the jet loads the cartridge. It has no code here. Counts in Save to DTC.
